title: Bridge USDB enters live Stripe and Bridge distribution
description: Bridge documented USDB as its live, issuer-managed dollar stablecoin on 2025-05-07, while contemporaneous Stripe rollout coverage identified USDB as one of the stablecoins used in Stripe Stablecoin Financial Accounts across more than 100 countries.
notes: The 2025-05-07 boundary is supported by Bridge's dated USDB announcement and contemporaneous launch coverage. Current Bridge documentation confirms continuing issuance, conversion and supported-chain availability.
